description: Generic properties describing how a 2D feature's geometry is interpreted with respect to the vertical dimension. A feature remains an authoritative 2D representation unless a legal vertical extent is explicitly described, supported by an authoritative source, and, where a 3D solid is created, capable of being computed and validated. This block is deliberately generic (not parcel-specific) so it can be reused by any 2D feature type gaining a 2.5D or 3D representation. Vocabulary value definitions (the terms referenced by the `*Status`, `*Role`, `*Type` and `direction`/`zValueRole` properties below) are managed as a separate artefact and are not defined here.

representationStatus.description: How the feature's spatial representation currently stands: 2D footprint only, 2.5D (footprint plus reference surface), height-described, jurisdictionally bounded, or derived 3D. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `representation-status:2d`).

geometryLegalStatus.description: Which geometry is legally authoritative for the feature: the 2D footprint, an observed surface, or geometry derived from a legal description. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `geometry-legal-status:a2d`).

computabilityStatus.description: Whether coordinate boundaries or geometry can be calculated from the information currently available. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `computability-status:nc`).

verticalBoundaryDefinitions.description: The source definitions (relative offset, absolute datum value, or jurisdictional rule) that establish or describe a vertical boundary. Kept separate from any computed/derived geometry — see `derivedGeometry`.

referenceSurfaces.description: Reference surfaces (terrain, ground, floor, or other surface) that provide vertical context for the feature. A reference surface supports analysis or visualisation; it is not by itself a legal vertical boundary.

coordinateRepresentation.description: Separates the dimensionality of the stored coordinates from the legal dimensionality of the feature. A feature can be legally 2D (`geometryLegalStatus` authoritative-2D) while its coordinates carry a contextual third ordinate.

coordinateDimension.description: The number of ordinates carried by the feature's coordinates.

zValueRole.description: What a third coordinate ordinate, if present, means: absent, a contextual geometry height, a reference-surface height, or a derived-boundary height. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `coordinate-z-role:absent`).

verticalExtent.description: The overall legal or source state of the feature's vertical extent, with the lower and upper boundary modelled independently so that each direction can carry its own state.

status.description: The overall legal or source state of the vertical extent. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `vertical-extent-status:ud`).

sourceReference.description: Identifier of the supporting source document, where the extent's status (e.g. a positively established unconstrained extent) is itself sourced.

verticalBoundary.description: The state of one vertical boundary (lower or upper) of the feature.

state.description: The state of this boundary: undefined, not applicable, unconstrained, defined but unresolved, defined, or derived. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `vertical-boundary-state:und`).

definitionRef.description: Identifier of the entry in `verticalBoundaryDefinitions` that establishes this boundary, when `state` indicates a source definition exists.

geometryRef.description: Identifier of the derived boundary geometry (e.g. an upper or lower surface) realising this boundary, when `state` is derived.

verticalBoundaryDefinition.description: A single source definition of a vertical boundary: a relative offset, an absolute datum value, or a jurisdictional rule. The `definitionType` discriminates which kind of definition this is.

id.description: Local identifier for this definition, referenced by `verticalExtent.lowerBoundary.definitionRef` / `upperBoundary.definitionRef` and by `derivedGeometry.inputDefinitionRefs`.

definitionType.description: The kind of source definition: relative height description, absolute height description, jurisdictional boundary rule, or geometry boundary reference. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `vertical-definition-type:rel`).

limitRole.description: Whether this definition establishes an upper or lower limit. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `vertical-limit-role:ll`).

valueType.description: How `value` is expressed: as an offset from a reference, or as an absolute height/depth. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `vertical-value-type:off`).

value.description: The numeric height, depth, or offset value.

direction.description: The direction in which `value` is expressed (above or below the reference), where relevant. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `vertical-direction:blw`).

heightReference.description: The surface, level, object, plane or datum that `value` is relative to. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `height-reference:gl`).

description.description: Human-readable description or verbatim source wording for this boundary definition.

comparisonOperator.description: The comparison implied by an absolute value, e.g. `lessThanOrEqual` or `greaterThanOrEqual`.

resolutionStatus.description: Whether this definition has been resolved into a computable absolute value, e.g. `requiresReferenceSurface`, `absoluteLimitAvailable`, or `resolved`.

sourceReference.description: Identifier of the supporting source document for this definition.

provenanceRef.description: Identifier of the PROV activity that extracted or derived this definition.

referenceSurface.description: A terrain, ground, floor, or other surface providing vertical context. A reference surface is supporting geometry; it is not automatically an upper or lower legal boundary.

id.description: Local identifier for this reference surface, referenced by `derivedGeometry.inputSurfaceRefs`.

surfaceType.description: What the surface represents, e.g. ground level. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `height-reference:gl`).

geometryLegalStatus.description: The legal/analytical status of the surface geometry itself. A vocabulary-referencing value (e.g. `geometry-legal-status:obs`).

ref.description: Reference to the surface's geometry, e.g. a surface feature collection identifier.

boundedByFootprint.description: Whether the surface is bounded by (contains) the feature's 2D footprint.

derivedGeometry.description: The computational result of converting sufficient source information (footprint, vertical boundary definitions, reference surfaces) into derived geometry, e.g. a closed 3D solid. Kept separate from the source definitions, which remain in `verticalBoundaryDefinitions`.

status.description: Whether derived geometry has been generated, e.g. `notGenerated` or `solidGenerated`.

geometryType.description: The type of derived geometry produced, e.g. `Solid`.

solidRef.description: Reference to the generated solid geometry.

inputFootprintRef.description: Reference to the 2D footprint used as an input to the derivation.

inputDefinitionRefs.description: References to the `verticalBoundaryDefinitions` entries used as inputs to the derivation.

inputSurfaceRefs.description: References to the `referenceSurfaces` entries used as inputs to the derivation.

sourceReference.description: Identifier(s) of the supporting source document(s) for the derivation.

provenanceRef.description: Identifier of the PROV activity that generated this derived geometry.
